name: Sticky geranium
desc: Sticky geranium (Geranium viscosissimum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Geranium viscosissimum, commonly known as the sticky purple geranium, is a perennial in the flowering plant family Geraniaceae. It is thought to be a protocarnivorous plant.
